title: The one I received does not oscillate but it heats fast; it's partially broken right out of the box
text:
The one I received does not oscillate but it heats fast; it's partially broken right out of the box. [[VIDEOID:fc5aec08f1488661939e768e5ce82915]] I actually ordered this for its oscillating feature and am extremely disappointed. This heater is sleekly designed and has a carry handle. There is supposed to be both an oscillating feature from 120 to 270 degrees and a non-oscillating feature. The LOW/HIGH dials to the left are used when the heater oscillation is not wanted. The LOW/HIGH dials to the right with the circular arrows are for the LOW or HIGH heat and the oscillating feature as well. There is supposedly a tip over button on the button, although I did not find it.

I feel uncomfortable using this because part of the unit is broken. I had high hopes and decided to order this based on other reviewers. That was my mistake. I cannot recommend this heater.

I see other have posted negative reviews since I last looked which tells me this is a substandard unit.

product_metadata.title: REMINGTON REM-211CF-120 Indoor and Outdoor Electric Heater
features: Portable Heater for Home, Office, Living Room
description: The Remington electric heater brings you heat any where you want it. Perfect for your home or desk, it easily fits on and under tables. This heater gives off radiant heat so it heats people, not the surrounding air. It has a low decibel for whisper quiet operation and a tip-over switch for your safety. The guard is cool to the touch with KOOL-Guard Technology. This electric heater has three oscillation settings; 120º, 270º, and 0º. It even has a weatherproof IPX4 rating for even more versatility. Heat things up with Remington.
